stories.title: Replacement buses for Flint and Shotton as North Wales Coast line closes for three weeks
stories.summary: No trains will call at Flint or Shotton on the North Wales Coast line for three weeks in January while Network Rail carries out £25m of engineering work. stories.summary: Two years after a major fire in Queensferry triggered an investigation into an illegal waste site no-one has been held accountable for the £1m clean-up operation. stories.title: Citizens Advice Cymru reports record debt levels among people seeking help in Wales
stories.summary: Citizens Advice helped nearly 194,000 people in Wales last year, with energy debt now the most common debt problem its advisers deal with. The figures are in Citizens Advice Cymru’s impact report for 2025-26, which covers the charity’s 18 local offices across Wales including Deeside and Mold.
